name: Yang Dimension / Characteristic-p Yang Dimension
details: The proposed uniform domination $\mathrm Y_2\ge\mathrm Y_p$ for every fixed prime $p$ is false already at $p=3$. On the Odd-Torsion Dual Class, $\mathrm Y_2=9<10=\mathrm Y_3$. This does not refute a reverse affine bound and does not concern the identity at $p=2$.
proof_source: Survey Corollary prop:yang-positive-characteristics-unordered refers to the database-owned exact value proofs for the two opposing finite witnesses.
witness_verification: At p=3 the exact values are Y_2=9 and Y_p=10, contradicting the displayed domination. Only strict finite failure, not an unbounded normalized ratio, is asserted.
